result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that renders mostly well. Found a few minor layout and content issues related to text truncation and cut-off elements at the horizontal scroll edge.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge, showing truncated name text without a clear affordance for horizontal scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Add a visible partial-card peek or scroll indicator, and ensure truncated names show an ellipsis consistently to signal more content is available by scrolling.

issues.description: The '-100%' badge on the pizza card is ambiguous and may confuse users about the actual discount or price.
issues.suggestion: Clarify the promotional label (e.g., 'Free' or '100% off') to avoid confusion.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card in 'Popular right now' is partially cut off by the fold, with its title and details not visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure adequate spacing so at least the card header is visible, reinforcing scrollability without appearing broken.
